You've lived on floor twelve your whole life. There is no floor thirteen.
Tonight, you step into the elevator. And there's a new button. Thirteen.
It's glowing. Nobody else is around.

text: You tell yourself it's just a glitch. Then you press it.

The elevator goes up. Slowly. Way longer than one floor should take.
It's a hallway. Exactly like yours. Same plant, same carpet, same doors.
But every number on every door is backwards.

text: And then, from the end of the hallway, someone calls your name.
